name: cards
prompt: An orderly fan of three ornate dark violet playing cards with no letters or numbers, ivory edges and tiny amethyst crescent seals, resting on dark oak archive desk. Clear close-up readable card silhouettes, one simple composition. Do not copy tarot cards.

name: relics
prompt: One open aged brass relic coffer on dark stone pedestal, containing a single glowing violet crescent talisman on plum velvet. Quiet candlelight. Clear readable coffer silhouette, rich craftsmanship, restrained magic, no coins or treasure avalanche.

name: potions
prompt: One elegant glass alchemical distillation apparatus with a large round flask of teal luminous liquid, brass piping and one smaller receiving vial on worn laboratory table. Clean strong silhouette, visually different from relic chest, no labels.

name: monsters
prompt: An open field bestiary on stone archive desk, ivory paper displaying an original black ink anatomical diagram of one thorn-armored gothic knight, subtle purple ink marginal geometric marks but no letters or text. Pen and one small brass compass. Diagram mysterious but readable, no gore.

name: story
prompt: One thick open chronicle book on dark stone lectern, a fine golden thread running across both ivory pages connecting five tiny round violet seals, faint illustrated cathedral silhouette on one page, no words or numbers. History and incomplete records symbolism, restrained candlelight.
